Dear [Mr Bullock](/person/221),
I think that with the book of Shropshire worthies I could manage [Fletcher](/person/1677)’s life. [Lady Falkland](/person/2408) is so well done in Miss Kavanagh’s [Women of Christianity](/periodical/91) that I think I could write her from thence.[^1] I suppose you are entirely at sea as to disposing of the book and cannot tell at all what you could allow the writers

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: The biographies of the Rev. John William Fletcher and of Lettice, Viscountess Falkland were among the [\'Biographies of Eminent Anglicans\'](/book/358) intended for Bullock\'s Daily Lections project, but were never published.
